sourceText:
Seven Layer Dip
By: Helen Pitlick
Published: Friday, December 18, 2009 - 11:27pm

Ingredients




1 can refried beans
1 cup Guacamole
1 cup grated cheese
1/2 cup mayonnaise
1/2 cup sour cream
1/2 package chili or taco seasoning mix
2 tomatoes, chopped fine
1 can chopped black olives
1 bunch chopped green onion tops too
1 small Jalapeño, chopped

Preparation

1 Layer in the order listed above, combining the mayonnaise, sour cream and seasoning mix together to form the fourth layer.

About


Serve with corn chips.
